messages:
Alex_M: Heads-up — we need to align the marketplace private-offer SKU with the HW partner co-sell and the SI launch next quarter. Can we define a commit-trigger that enables a joint announcement without blocking SI onboarding?

Jamie_Sales: +1. The field wants something simple: customer signs private offer -> gets HW kicker + initial onboarding credits. Need clarity on renewal cliffs. :eyes:

Rita_Partners: Proposed pattern: keep a soft commit floor (e.g., $X/month equivalent) that unlocks HW rebate and an onboarding credit bucket that expires at 12 months. No hard ML consumption cliff. Works for partners because it's predictable but not punitive.

Tom_HW: From HW side we need a minimum attach rate to justify the device discount. Can the private offer include a metered SKU for on-prem activation so we can measure attach?

Alex_M: Yes — include a metered attestation SKU. Finance asked that metered numbers map to the private-offer consumption for reporting, so credits apply programmatically.

Eldon_SE: Technical note: for SI onboarding, we should allow staged enablement. i.e., initial dev seats + phased production tokens. That way announcement can go live once dev seats are provisioned.

CloudOpsBot: Reminder: marketplace private offers cannot auto-apply partner-managed credits. We'll need a redemption flow or a mapping table on our side. See https://marketplace.docs/private-offers for constraints.

Sara_Finance: To make the math simple for renewals, suggest: Year1 commit = committed consumption + onboarding credit. Year2 renewal baseline = max(committed consumption * 0.9, actual Year1 consumption). This avoids punishing initial growth stalls.

Jamie_Sales: That renewal formula looks good to commercial. Can we also provide a 60-day notice window before the renewal calculation kicks in? Sales wants runway to discuss upsell.

Rita_Partners: Timeline ask: partner marketing needs a coordinated announcement 3 weeks after we sign the first customer. That requires legal and marketplace listing ready by then. Can legal confirm SLA/PR language? @Alex_M can you loop in legal?

Alex_M: Yep — looping legal. For the marketplace listing, we need these fields: commit band mapping, SKU ids for HW kicker, onboarding credit SKU, and the metered attach SKU. Sample mapping we're proposing: 
```
commit_band_low: 50k/year => rebate 8%
commit_band_mid: 200k/year => rebate 12% + 25k onboarding credits
commit_band_high: 500k/year => rebate 18% + 75k onboarding credits
metered_attach_sku: hw-attach-v1
onboard_credit_sku: rwd-onboard-credits-v1
```

Tom_HW: Those bands look sensible. HW discount tied to commit band is fine. Need a clause that allows HW rebate to be reclaimed if attach < 40% after 9 months. Is that acceptable?

Sara_Finance: Reclaim clause ok but prefer a remediation path: if attach < 40%, give 60 days to remediate (SI deliverables, enablement) before reclamation. Also need credit accounting flow in our billing exports.

Eldon_SE: For remediation we can provide a checklist and enablement playbook. I’ll draft the SI deliverables we expect the partner to complete in the 60-day window.

Jamie_Sales: Quick ask — can marketing produce joint announcement template and social assets in advance? Partners want co-branding options.

Rita_Partners: Yes — marketing will prep a draft. We should lock the commit bands and the announcement date 5 business days before sign so partners can review.

Alex_M: Action items: (1) Legal review SLA/announcement wording (Rita -> legal) (2) Billing/engineers to add SKU mapping and redemption flow (Eldon/Sara -> eng infra) (3) Marketing to draft assets (Rita -> marketing) (4) HW partner to confirm attach measurement and remediation (Tom)

Tom_HW: Confirmed — I'll get device telemetry contract language to Alex by EOD tomorrow.

Eldon_SE: I'll open a ticket for the redemption flow and add the sample mapping above. ETA 5 working days.

Sara_Finance: I'll produce a renewal calc sheet and export spec for billing by Friday.

Rita_Partners: Fine. If all blocks cleared, we can target a soft launch (announce + one customer case) in Week 6.

Jamie_Sales: Thanks everyone — I'll sync field expectations and update the partner playbook. :thumbsup:

Alex_M: Great. Tag me on blockers. If we get legal + billing confirmed, we can finalize the private-offer template and publish to the marketplace listing.
